pages.title: Calorimeter Detector Array
pages.text: An array of scintillator crystals and pixel trackers that records where a particle went and how much energy it carried. A quantum processor reads the flashes. The crystals glow faintly when hit. Tiny flashes ripple across it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To know what a collision produced I needed to measure both position and energy. I combined scintillators for energy, pixel trackers for paths and a quantum processor to read them.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Nuclide Forge, Particle Spectrometer.
